title: Seven default questions phase 6: a Joomla page the customer ticked stays when the demo trim took it off; pages at any menu depth are listed and kept or removed by path; uploaded logos on JA Essence, Resort and Impact j6 are capped at the demo logo's height; an unticked WordPress page leaves the navigation inside template parts and an emptied submenu goes; a Polylang site written in one other language names its source locale; the Tracy Business 1.3.4, Tracy Base 1.1.2 and JA Morgan 1.1.12 WordPress contracts are complete; an EmDash template hide rule yields to a kept page
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/joomla-ticked-trimmed-page.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/joomla-nested-pages.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-brand-joomla.test.mjs
S4: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts of each run.
expect: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.
Joomla: a ticked page whose menu item the demo trim unpublished is published again, with its parent heading; unticking a child removes only that item, and a heading left without children goes too.

WordPress: an unticked page's link is removed from wp_navigation posts and from navigation written inside template parts, matched by page id or by this site's own path; a submenu that lost every link goes.

WordPress: a Polylang site written in one non-English language writes tracy_source_locale next to WPLANG; the 1.3.4 profile carries inventory, editions and demo-trim map, and a later release that drops an inventory is refused.
EmDash: the brief sends keepPages and personalize.mjs applies no template hide rule (REG-PR-1034-hide-only-unticked-pages).

selectors.joomla_pages: apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines (Joomla clean-up step, page ids as menu paths)
selectors.emdash_keep: keepPages in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/emdash.js and tools/personalize.mjs of the three EmDash themes

evidence: 08/10/2026: defects A-J measured on cowork.tracy.site after #1024 while re-checking the seven default questions (issue #1013 phase 6, plan tasks/plan-ten-logo-favicon.md).
fence: Units over fake Apply doors and contract files. Not exercised here: a running Joomla or WordPress site, Claude Cowork WordPress 0.18.3, a released Tracy SaaS 1.4.1, the dev surface.
